title: Entity
description: A named thing the claims are about (housamkak v3 §6.4) — one line of llm-wiki/states/entities.jsonl, a view aggregated from every observation that names it. entity_id is the normalized name (lowercase, runs of non-alphanumerics to _); a mention resolves to the first-seen entity whose name or alias it matches, and merges.jsonl rows fold one entity into another on replay. type is one of the wiki's page types: an entity with enough live claims renders as the page wiki/<shelf>/<slug>.md.

aliases.description: Every other spelling seen for the entity — its own mentions' aliases plus the names and aliases of entities merged into it — in first-seen order.

merged_from.description: Entity ids folded into this one by merges.jsonl rows, in ledger order; empty for most entities.

attributes.description: Free key/value facts about the entity, e.g. vendor or category.

confidence.description: Belief that the entity is real and correctly identified — log-odds accumulated over every observation naming it, as a probability.

page.description: Repo-relative path of the rendered page — under llm-wiki/private/wiki/<shelf>/ for a private-segment entity, llm-wiki/wiki/<shelf>/ for a shared one — or null when the entity is below the page threshold.
